agent_explanation: Single ball dropped from y=1.9 hits arena floor at step 91. Inbound speed ~18.34 with e=0.5 should rebound at ~9.2, but rebounds at ~28.96, more than tripling kinetic energy (176J -> 427J). With e=0 the same impact still rebounds at ~19.79 upward (gain vs 18.34 inbound), proving the floor contact solver (impulse + positional correction snapping y to exactly r) injects energy on a penetrating high-speed contact rather than dissipating it.
